derivation: from a compound of G473 (ἀντί) and G3408 (μισθός);

occurrences.text: And likewise also the men, leaving the natural use of the woman, burned in their lust one toward another; men with men working that which is unseemly, and receiving in themselves that recompence of their error which was meet.
Now for a recompence in the same, (I speak as unto my children,) be ye also enlarged.
